title: Style guide front-matter
description: Contract for specs/content/style-guide.md front-matter (Spec 006 FR-007). The `version` field is the single freeze marker for both the style guide and the terminology bank as a pair (Spec 006 FR-017, research.md R8) — bumping it is required for any further edit to either document. Spec 007 (content depth standard) sets it to "2.0" when the `## Unit depth standard` section is added and proven on the EFMP-302 Unit 1 proving unit; Spec 008 (rich unit pedagogy) sets it to "3.0" as the freeze marker for the `## Unit structure standard` / `## Answers and marking guidance policy` / `## Figure markers and manifests` sections — the existing `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` pattern already admits "3.0", so this is a description-only note, no structural change. terminology.csv carries no version field of its own.

version.description: e.g. '1.0', '2.0'. Freezing a version means this field is set to that value; any later edit to the style guide or terminology.csv requires bumping it. Spec 006 froze '1.0'; Spec 007 freezes '2.0' (adds the '## Unit depth standard' section).
